_doc: Thresholds for the quality gates in ~/.claude/hooks/verify.sh and mutation.sh. Edit freely; every run appends to ~/.claude/loop-state/quality/<repo>.jsonl so the trend is visible. CRAP per method = CC^2 * uncovered^3 + CC (CC = cyclomatic complexity, uncovered = 1 - coverage). Only methods whose lines the diff touches are scored. Mutation uses Pest's built-in --mutate on the changed classes with the mapped tests.

pest._doc: verify.sh runs the chosen pest files in this many shards at once, one provisioned <db>_test_<n> database each (LARAVEL_PARALLEL_TESTING + TEST_TOKEN); coverage dumps are merged by merge-coverage.php

crap.rule: ratchet: above max is RED only when the diff made the method worse (new, complexity grew, or a changed line uncovered); otherwise DEBT, listed, not blocking

mutation.runs_in: handoff, after the push; advisory, never blocks the PR
mutation.scope: lines this diff added in the changed classes (hooks/mutate-lines.php overrides Pest's generator), covered lines only; falls back to the whole class if the override does not load, and the receipt says so; on timeout the receipt is PARTIAL unless a survivor sits on an added line
